name: BUNDLE loop (dch + hold penalty)
verdict: C1 + C2 (retained) + C6 in one model; C5 in range only (Note 259-4: BUNDLE 0/2, FAIL: C5)

memory.name: DeltaMem
memory.read: x <- x + W_o [additive || delta heads](LN(x)); W_o = 0 at init
memory.additive_heads: 6: S <- S + phi(k) v^T (phi = elu + 1), read phi(q)^T S
memory.delta_heads: 6 gated-delta: S <- alpha S (I - beta k k^T) + beta v k^T, read S q
memory.write_from: final-layer state at the ':' of ' The answer is:' (one token per pass)

pass.count: K = 8 think passes (accuracy appears once K' >= d - 1 and holds to K' 14)
pass.input: [EOT] + problem text + 'How many <unit> does S_t have?' + ' The answer is:'
pass.cue: per-pass step cue names the step's subject S_t (the plan is given)
pass.lower_cache: blocks 0-5 computed once per distinct input and reused

decoder: a final direct-format pass reads the memory S_K (read-only) and answers; it adds one hop itself
aux: training only: per pass t <= d, '[EOT] Step t :' + the step's value, read-only on S_t (aux_step 1, reweighted)

training_lineage.what: GPT-2 small fine-tuned to answer 'How many u does X have?' from the text
+ 0-2 irrelevant op sentences per item (new names), 16k
+ hold-increment penalty (lambda 1.6, from step 500), 8k from dch

scorecard.evidence: TEST2 d1-4 1.000; NOT-DECODER 0.020 / 0.019; SWAP4 / LP5 pass; content step selection inherited from dch (held-out distractors 0.95 / 0.96, §257); still order-bound
acc K'128 = K'8 at d1-6 (d6 0.972 / 0.958); ||S|| ratio 1.02-1.14x; no-penalty control drifts (Note 259-4)

training-free rule 'stop when the answer is unchanged for 2 passes' (uses the C6 hold): s1 extrapolates to d5-7 within 0.02 (d7 0.838 vs 0.857), s2 loses 0.03-0.04 at d6-7; costs ~2 extra passes (Note 259-8). Learned heads: in range only (Note 259-6). Post-hoc r = 3: both seeds keep accuracy to within 0.007 at d5-7 for a fixed +3 passes (Note 259-10; needs a fresh-data confirmation).
per-pass value targets used; answer-only extension is rare (§255, 1/4)
~9x fewer serial layers, 1.5-3x more FLOPs (prompt recomputed each pass)
text fed back through the write is ignored (§247); untested on dch

limits: Plan given by the step cue
Sentences must be in chain order
Templated word programs (REG frames 0-5), values mod 11
Chain-reading distractors tested only right after the step they read
GPT-2 small only (§258 medium: no pass-2 write at lr 3e-5; lr 1e-4 retry running)
Content selection not re-scored on bun (inherited from dch)
